note: Town of Hinton campground at the Hinton Centre on Switzer Drive, two minutes off Hwy 16, run under contract by Yellowhead Property Services: treed sites with fire pits and free firewood, a cook shack and a playground, with no gate. The washrooms need a passcode between 7 p.m. and 9 a.m. A train line and a road are close and can be heard at night. Monthly and seasonal stays are also sold. --Claude
summary: Still a public nightly campground: the town's facility page links a new operator booking site with per-site online booking at C$30 a night. Added no hookups, 40 sites up to 50 ft, potable water, the booking channel and the rate; phone on both pages differs from the stored one. No season dates are posted for this campground.
flags: PHONE: stored 780-865-0876 is not on either page. The Town of Hinton page lists the contact as Yellowhead Property Services, (780) 315-9196, and the booking site and Google Maps give the same 780-315-9196. Recommend replacing.
WEBSITE: stored town page answers 200; the booking site it links, https://www.hintoncampground.ca/ (200), is the operator's own page with rates and per-site availability - recommend adding it.

SEASONAL / MONTHLY: the booking form offers 'Monthly - $800/month' and 'Seasonal - $3,000/season' beside the nightly rate and the town page says 'Monthly stays welcomed'. Neither page says how many of the 40 sites are held by monthly or seasonal campers; every site was listed with a nightly price and a Book Now button. Local-government campground, so the long-stay tests are for the reviewer.
SEASON: not stated for this campground on either page (the same site says 'Season May - Oct' only for the operator's other campground, Maskuta Creek); nothing written.
SITE COUNT: town page '39 sites', operator site '40 sites' with sites numbered 1-40; 40 written. Six sites are listed at 20 ft and about five as tent only; the rest are 25-50 ft.

LEAD (not vetted): the same operator site sells Maskuta Creek Campground west of Hinton off Hwy 16 (53.3072,-117.7068 per its map link): 14 no-hookup sites sold only as a whole-campground group booking at $200 a night - group-only, so not an add.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): no water near the loops on Esri imagery; highway on the west, rail line on the south-east.
PIN: 53.40620,-117.57230 falls at the north end of the camping loops (loop centre about 53.4058,-117.5727); no move. Google rating 4.1 from 124 reviews.
